content.title: Is Rory McIlroy Still Married? What to Know About Wife Erica Stoll
content.text: Getty Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland looks on with wife Erica Stoll during the Par 3 Contest prior to the Masters at Augusta National Golf Club. As Rory McIlroy makes a strong push at the Masters and sits near the top of the leaderboard, interest in his personal life has surged — including a question many fans are asking: Is he still married to Erica Stoll? The short answer: Yes — McIlroy and Stoll are still together. Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll Remain Together GettyAUGUSTA, GEORGIA – APRIL 08: Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland, wife Erica Stoll and daughter Poppy pose for a photo during the Par Three Contest prior to the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 08, 2026 in Augusta, Georgia. McIlroy and Erica Stoll have been married since 2017 and share a daughter, Poppy, who was born in 2020. While the couple has kept a relatively private profile in recent years, Stoll has been seen during Masters week at Augusta National Golf Club, supporting McIlroy as he competes. Their recent public appearances — including during the Par 3 Contest — suggest the couple remains together. Why Questions About Their Relationship Surfaced Questions about their relationship intensified in 2024, when reports emerged that McIlroy had filed for divorce. That situation, however, was short-lived. McIlroy later addressed the matter publicly, saying: “Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning.” Since then, the couple has largely stayed out of the spotlight. How Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll Met McIlroy and Stoll first met in 2012 at the Ryder Cup, where she was working as a PGA transport official. Their story became widely known after Stoll helped McIlroy avoid missing his tee time at Medinah by arranging a police escort to get him to the course. The pair began dating publicly in 2014 and married three years later. Family Back in Focus During Masters Week GettyRory McIlroy sits with his daughter Poppy during the Par 3 Contest prior to the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia. With McIlroy in contention once again at Augusta National, his family has returned to the spotlight. Stoll and their daughter Poppy participated in the Par 3 Contest, a Masters tradition that gives fans a glimpse into players’ lives off the course. McIlroy has spoken openly about fatherhood, often highlighting how much he enjoys seeing his daughter take an interest in golf. The Par 3 Contest is one of the few times all week when Augusta slows down. Families are inside the ropes, kids are on the greens, and the focus briefly shifts away from the leaderboard. For McIlroy, those moments have taken on more weight. As he heads into the weekend in contention, with the pressure of a long-awaited green jacket building, having his wife and daughter close by offers a different kind of stability — one that doesn’t show up on a scorecard. The Bottom Line As McIlroy chases his second Masters title, his personal life has once again drawn attention. For now, all signs — both publicly and during Masters week — indicate that he and Stoll remain together. Maggie MacKenzie Maggie MacKenzie covers NASCAR for Heavy.com.
